text: dsh-desk-card 是面向 Windows 桌面版 DSH 的原生桌面提醒插件，会在右下角显示审批、提问、任务完成和报错卡片。它由 DSH 宿主监听请求与 agent 状态，再启动 PowerShell/WPF 窗口呈现内容；审批可直接在卡片上放行，也可点击卡片回到 DSH 处理。完成提醒会显示最近消息摘要、耗时、待办和 token 用量。卡片可配置语言、缩放、显示类别与自动关闭时间，并在全屏或勿扰状态下跳过。需要 Windows、PowerShell/WPF 和 DSH 桌面 profile，不需要 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-desk-card adds Windows desktop cards for DSH approvals, questions, completed turns, and errors. PowerShell/WPF cards let users approve requests in place or return to DSH. Configure language and timeouts; skip cards during fullscreen or Do Not Disturb. Requires Windows and DSH desktop profile.
想在 DSH 桌面版弹出审批卡片，并能直接点按钮批准工具请求。
希望 DSH 有新问题、任务完成或运行报错时，通过 Windows 桌面卡片提醒我。
I want desktop alerts for DSH approvals and task updates, while suppressing cards during fullscreen apps.
dsh-desk-card 的「审批卡片」功能：工具请求需要授权时显示请求理由，并可直接确认允许一次，或点击卡片回到 DSH 界面处理。
dsh-desk-card 的「任务状态卡片」功能：agent 提问、报错或一轮正常结束时显示桌面提醒；完成卡片还汇总最近消息、耗时、待办与 token 用量。

dsh-desk-card README · dsh-desk-card：Bottom-right native desktop cards for **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** approvals, questions, turn
completion and errors.

Each card is a small always-on-top window drawn by PowerShell/WPF — not a system toast — so it
can carry a button that answers the request. An approval can be allowed straight from the card,
and the moment a card would interrupt something else (a fullscreen app, a game, Do-Not-Disturb)
it is skipped and the decision goes back to the normal DSH UI.
dsh-desk-card README · dsh-desk-card：Windows only. No dependencies, no network, no build step.

dsh-desk-card README · Why not just a toast：| | system toast | this card |
|---|---|---|
| carries a button that returns an answer | depends on the shell / extra runtime | yes, the card's own button |
| can allow an approval in place | no (toasts only focus the app) | yes — `确认允许` / `Allow` |
| respects fullscreen games and Do-Not-Disturb | only if the OS suppresses it | explicit gate, checked before the window is drawn |
| UI language | whatever the OS shows | follows the DSH locale, or forced with `language` |

dsh-desk-card README · Requirements：- Windows 10/11 (cards are drawn with `powershell.exe` + WPF, which ship with Windows).
- DSH desktop profile (the cards are injected by the **host** process, no browser side needed).
- Node.js 20+ (whatever DSH ships is fine).

dsh-desk-card README · Install：From this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanshang328/dsh-desk-card
```

Or from a local clone / download:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-desk-card
```

Then restart DSH. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the CLI records it in
`dsh.profile.bundles` and mounts it as a normal profile layer — no hand-written paths.

dsh-desk-card README · Install：Windows developer helper: `powershell.exe -File tools/deploy-local.ps1` copies the working tree
into `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-desk-card` and registers it the same way.

dsh-desk-card README · What shows up：| card | when | auto-close | buttons |
|---|---|---|---|
| Approval | a tool call needs permission | never (waits for you) | `确认允许` / `Allow` approves once · clicking the card opens DSH for the full dialog |
| Question | the agent asks you something | never, closes when the question is answered | `知道了` / `Got it` |
| Completion | a turn ends normally | `doneTimeoutSeconds` (default 5s) | `知晓` / `OK` |
| Error | a turn fails | never | `知道了` / `Got it` |

dsh-desk-card README · What shows up：The completion card also carries a short summary of your last message, the elapsed time, the
remaining todo count and the turn/session token usage.

Cards never overlap: a new card stacks above the ones already on screen. If the DSH window is
closed while a card is open, the card closes itself too.

dsh-desk-card README · Configuration：Everything has a built-in default, so this section is optional. To change something, add a row
with the same id from your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-desk-card
      name: dsh-desk-card
      config:

Only the keys you list are changed — a `config` object replaces the whole object, and every key
you leave out falls back to the defaults below.

dsh-desk-card README · Configuration：| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutSeconds` | `0` | auto-close seconds for cards that wait for **you** (approval / question). `0` = stay until answered |
| `doneTimeoutSeconds` | `5` | auto-close seconds for the completion card. `0` = keep it until clicked |
| `scale` | `1.2` | card scale factor |
| `skipWhenFullscreen` | `true` | skip cards while a fullscreen app is in the foreground, or while Windows says Do-Not-Disturb |
| `notifyQuestions` | `true` | show the question card |
| `notifyErrors` | `true` | show the error card |
| `notifyDone` | `true` | show the completion card |
| `language` | `auto` | `auto` (follow the DSH locale), `zh` or `en` |
| `hostProcess` | `DeepSeek Harness` | the process whose window is brought to front when you click a card |

dsh-desk-card README · Configuration：The three `notify*` switches only control the cards — approvals and questions always keep
working, the card just does not appear.

dsh-desk-card README · The fullscreen gate：A card is not drawn when either of these is true:

- `SHQueryUserNotificationState` reports a fullscreen app, presentation mode or Do-Not-Disturb; or
- the foreground window covers its whole monitor and is not the desktop (this keeps games that
  hide the real state from being interrupted).

dsh-desk-card README · The fullscreen gate：When a card is skipped the approval is handed back to the normal DSH UI (with `prepend: true`
this plugin speaks first, and a skipped card always delegates to the next answerer), so nothing
gets stuck. Two test tools reproduce the condition without a game:

```powershell
powershell.exe -File test/gate-probe.ps1 -MaxSeconds 20          # watch the gate flip blocked -> free
powershell.exe -File test/fake-fullscreen.ps1 -HoldSeconds 8     # paint a fullscreen window for 8s
```

dsh-desk-card README · How it works：```
lib/index.js      host half: listens to approval/request, user-questions/request,
                  agent/error, agent/status; spawns one card per event and maps the
                  card's exit code back to an approval outcome.
scripts/card.ps1  render half: one PowerShell process per card. Runs the gate, draws the

Exit-code protocol between the two halves:

dsh-desk-card README · How it works：| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| `10` | the card's primary button was pressed |
| `12` | the card body was clicked — bring the DSH window to the front, let the UI decide |
| `0` | gate skipped the card (fullscreen / Do-Not-Disturb) |
| `3` | rendering failed |

Being one process per card keeps the render half stateless: a card can never wedge the host,
and a card that is killed by the OS just delegates the decision.

dsh-desk-card README · Logs and troubleshooting：`%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log` records card placement, exit codes, config and gate decisions:

```
apply() started config={"skipWhenFullscreen":true,...}
showCard[approval]: exit 10
approval resolved: allowed-once
done card (41234ms, autoClose=5s)

Cards are spawned without a console window. If no card ever appears, check in order: a
fullscreen app is holding the gate (`-SkipWhenFullscreen false` for a manual test), PowerShell
is blocked by policy for the DSH process, and finally the log file.

dsh-desk-card README · Logs and troubleshooting：Manual card render (bypasses the host half entirely):

```powershell
$payload = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"badge":"test","head":"hello","body":"line","okLabel":"OK","okCode":10}'))
powershell.exe -File scripts/card.ps1 -Payload $payload -TimeoutSeconds 5 -Scale 1.2 -SkipWhenFullscreen false -DebugLog "$env:TEMP\card-test.log"
```

dsh-desk-card README · Limitations：- Windows only. The render half is PowerShell + WPF; there is no macOS/Linux path.
- Cards are ordinary top-level windows, so they appear above other windows but not above a
  fullscreen exclusive game — which is why the gate exists.
- One PowerShell process per card (about 100 ms of warm-up). A card is not a notification
  center entry: once it is closed it is gone.
- This plugin deliberately does **not** restart or shut down DSH. If you want power controls,
  [dsh-power-button](https://github.com/keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button) and
  [dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart) do that well.

dsh-desk-card README · Privacy：The host half never opens a socket and never reads a file. It spawns one local PowerShell
process per card and appends a line to `%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log`. Card payloads contain short
excerpts of your session (task title, tool name, approval reason, error message) and are passed
to that child process as a command-line argument.

dsh-desk-card README · dsh-desk-card：**DSH（DeepSeek Harness）**的右下角原生桌面卡片：审批请求、提问、任务完成、任务报错。

卡片不是系统通知，而是由 PowerShell/WPF 自绘的小窗口（始终置顶），因此卡片上可以带一个
真正能「回答请求」的按钮：审批可以直接在卡片上放行。而在会打扰你的时候（全屏应用、游戏、
勿扰模式）卡片直接跳过，把决定权交回 DSH 界面。

仅 Windows。零依赖、不联网、无需构建。

dsh-desk-card README · 为什么不用系统 Toast：| | 系统通知 | 本卡片 |
|---|---|---|
| 带一个能返回结果的按钮 | 取决于系统/额外运行时 | 可以，按钮是卡片自己画的 |
| 直接在通知上放行审批 | 不行（只能把应用拉到前台） | 可以：`确认允许` / `Allow` |
| 尊重全屏游戏与勿扰模式 | 只能靠系统压掉 | 画窗口之前先过闸门 |
| 文案语言 | 系统决定 | 跟随 DSH 语言，也可用 `language` 固定 |

dsh-desk-card README · 运行要求：- Windows 10/11（卡片用 `powershell.exe` + WPF 绘制，系统自带）。
- DSH 桌面版 profile（卡片由**宿主**进程注入，不需要浏览器侧挂件）。
- Node.js 20+（DSH 自带的即可）。

dsh-desk-card README · 安装：从本仓库安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanshang328/dsh-desk-card
```

或用本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-desk-card
```

然后重启 DSH。包里声明了 `dsh.bundle`，CLI 会把它记进 `dsh.profile.bundles` 并作为一个普通的
profile 层挂载，不需要手写任何绝对路径。

Windows 开发辅助脚本：`powershell.exe -File tools/deploy-local.ps1` 会把工作区复制到
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-desk-card` 并用同样的方式注册。

dsh-desk-card README · 会出现哪些卡片：| 卡片 | 触发时机 | 自动关闭 | 按钮 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 审批 | 某个工具调用需要授权 | 不关（等你处理） | `确认允许` 直接放行一次 · 点卡片打开 DSH 看完整对话框 |
| 提问 | agent 需要你回答 | 不关，直到问题被回答 | `知道了` |
| 完成 | 一轮正常结束 | `doneTimeoutSeconds`（默认 5 秒） | `知晓` |
| 报错 | 一轮失败 | 不关 | `知道了` |

完成卡片还会带上你最后一条消息的摘要、本轮耗时、剩余待办数量，以及本轮/本会话的 token 消耗。

卡片之间不会重叠：新卡片会叠在已有卡片的上面。DSH 窗口关掉时，还开着的卡片会一起关闭。

dsh-desk-card README · 配置：所有配置都有内置默认值，这一节可以完全不看。要改动，就在你自己的 profile
`cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）里加一条同 id 的行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-desk-card
      name: dsh-desk-card
      config:

只写你要改的键即可：`config` 对象是整体替换的，没写的键会回落到下面的默认值。

dsh-desk-card README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutSeconds` | `0` | 需要**你**处理的卡片（审批/提问）的自动关闭秒数，`0` = 一直留着 |
| `doneTimeoutSeconds` | `5` | 完成卡片的自动关闭秒数，`0` = 一直留到点击 |
| `scale` | `1.2` | 卡片缩放 |
| `skipWhenFullscreen` | `true` | 全屏应用在前台、或系统处于勿扰模式时跳过卡片 |
| `notifyQuestions` | `true` | 是否显示提问卡片 |
| `notifyErrors` | `true` | 是否显示报错卡片 |
| `notifyDone` | `true` | 是否显示完成卡片 |
| `language` | `auto` | `auto`（跟随 DSH 语言）/ `zh` / `en` |
| `hostProcess` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 点卡片时被拉到前台的进程名 |
dsh-desk-card README · 配置：三个 `notify*` 开关只控制「卡片显不显示」，审批与提问链路始终照常工作。

dsh-desk-card README · 全屏闸门：满足任一条件就不画卡片：

- `SHQueryUserNotificationState` 报告全屏应用、演示模式或勿扰；或
- 前台窗口铺满它所在的显示器，且不是桌面（应对隐藏了真实状态的全屏游戏）。

卡片被跳过后，审批会交回 DSH 原来的界面（本插件以 `prepend: true` 先说话，被跳过时一定
`next()` 交回下游），不会卡住。不用开游戏也能复现：

```powershell
powershell.exe -File test/gate-probe.ps1 -MaxSeconds 20          # 观察闸门 blocked -> free
powershell.exe -File test/fake-fullscreen.ps1 -HoldSeconds 8     # 画一个 8 秒的全屏窗口
```

dsh-desk-card README · 工作原理：```
lib/index.js      宿主侧：监听 approval/request、user-questions/request、agent/error、
                  agent/status；每个事件起一张卡片，并把卡片进程的退出码翻译成审批结果。
scripts/card.ps1  渲染侧：一张卡片一个 PowerShell 进程。先过闸门，再画 WPF 窗口、
                  叠到兄弟卡片上方、跑计时器，最后用退出码把结果告诉宿主侧。

两半之间的退出码协议：

| 退出码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `10` | 按下了卡片的主按钮 |
| `12` | 点击了卡片正文——把 DSH 窗口拉到前台，交给界面处理 |
| `0` | 闸门跳过了卡片（全屏 / 勿扰） |
| `3` | 渲染失败 |

一张卡片一个进程，渲染侧因此完全无状态：卡片不可能拖死宿主，被系统杀掉的卡片等价于
「交给界面处理」。

dsh-desk-card README · 日志与排查：`%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log` 会记录卡片位置、退出码、配置与闸门判定：

```
apply() started config={"skipWhenFullscreen":true,...}
showCard[approval]: exit 10
approval resolved: allowed-once
done card (41234ms, autoClose=5s)

卡片进程没有控制台窗口。如果一直不弹卡片，依次检查：全屏应用占着闸门（手动测试可加
`-SkipWhenFullscreen false`）、DSH 进程的 PowerShell 被策略拦了、最后看日志文件。

手动渲染一张卡片（完全绕过宿主侧）：

dsh-desk-card README · 日志与排查：```powershell
$payload = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"badge":"test","head":"hello","body":"line","okLabel":"OK","okCode":10}'))
powershell.exe -File scripts/card.ps1 -Payload $payload -TimeoutSeconds 5 -Scale 1.2 -SkipWhenFullscreen false -DebugLog "$env:TEMP\card-test.log"
```

dsh-desk-card README · 已知限制：- 仅 Windows：渲染侧是 PowerShell + WPF，没有 macOS/Linux 实现。
- 卡片是普通的顶层窗口，能盖住其他窗口，但盖不住独占全屏的游戏——这正是闸门存在的原因。
- 一张卡片一个 PowerShell 进程（冷启动约 100ms）。卡片不是通知中心条目，关掉就没了。
- 本插件**不做**重启/关机。要电源控制请用
  [dsh-power-button](https://github.com/keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button) 或
  [dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart)。

dsh-desk-card README · 隐私：宿主侧不开任何网络端口、不读任何文件：每张卡片起一个本地 PowerShell 进程，并往
`%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log` 追加一行。卡片内容包含会话的短摘录（任务标题、工具名、审批理由、
错误信息），以命令行参数的形式传给那个子进程。
